name: Brainstorm
abilities: Super-genius intellect (IQ ~10^30; instant calculation and prediction)
Bio-electrokinesis from his exposed brain (blasts, beams that downed Ship, controllable voltage)
Technokinesis (took control of machinery, a Yeti's neural implant)
Force fields and electrical pulses (toppled Ultimate Cannonbolt)
weaknesses: Must open his skull plates and concentrate to fire electricity; headaches (sonic screams) impair him
Shocks his own brain if plates are closed while discharging
Electric attacks ineffective vs Shock Staff / Vicetopus
Physically slow; struggles on slippery surfaces
summary: A crab-shelled super-genius who opens his skull to hurl bio-electricity and out-thinks every opponent; Ben's smartest Alien Force form.
traits: British accent in AF/UA, Austrian in OV
Opens cranium plates to reveal his brain
notableFeats: Defeated Ship and protected Julie in his debut (Pier Pressure)
Piloted Ship in Battle Mode to Augstaka (War of the Worlds: Part 2)
Built a Pyroxovore pen from a train (Inferno)
Took control of a Yeti to capture Dr. Animo (Escape From Aggregor)
Defeated Sentient Ultimate Cannonbolt (The Ultimate Sacrifice)
Defeated the Vengers and engineered their break-up (The Vengers)

appearances.designNotes: Rust-coloured crab body with six two-jointed legs, pincers, openable skull plates over a pink brain; silver/black neck brace holding the recalibrated Omnitrix symbol; yellow electricity.
Same design as Alien Force with Ultimatrix on the neck brace. Heroes United cameo was more vibrant orange with black skull plates.

Four single-jointed legs, black loincloth with green stripe, black/green head stripe, longer face spines, eyes joined by a black forehead band, elbow spikes; Omnitrix on a white-and-green neck brace; green electricity.

image.label: OV
image.notes: infobox OV render (file redirects to Brainstorm_ov.png)

scoring.rationale: Genius-tier intellect (10) that predicts and out-plans opponents, backed by strong electrokinesis - beams that shot Ship down, telekinetic lifting of trains, technokinetic control and shields that toppled Ultimate Cannonbolt. Slow, physically modest, and his powers need concentration and open skull plates.

notes: UA 'Fame'/'Video Games' entries were on-screen footage only; first true UA transformation is Escape From Aggregor.
Also used by Albedo (Negative Brainstorm, UA dream and OV).
AF S1 (wiki) = ben-15-af, AF S2 = ben-16-af.
